Project overview

A reproducible portfolio risk analysis using historical equity data, Monte Carlo simulation, GARCH(1,1) volatility modelling, and joint residual bootstrap sampling.

Methodology

Multivariate-normal Monte Carlo

Uses estimated joint return behaviour and covariance to generate correlated simulated returns.

GARCH(1,1) + residual bootstrap

Models time-varying volatility and resamples aligned standardized residual vectors.

Out-of-sample validation

Compares volatility forecasts against an expanding historical-variance baseline using QLIKE.

See the linked methodology and validation reports for detailed definitions and assumptions.

Limitations and interpretation

  • Simulation outputs are model-based scenarios, not predictions or guarantees.
  • Results depend on historical data, assumptions, configuration, and random seed.
  • VaR and Expected Shortfall must be interpreted with their confidence level, horizon, and loss definition.
  • Out-of-sample validation measures historical holdout performance; it does not guarantee future forecast accuracy.

Educational analytics only; not investment advice.

Run the project locally

From the project root, activate your virtual environment and install the project requirements.

pip install -r requirements.txt
python create_dashboard.py
python -m http.server 8000 --directory docs

Open http://localhost:8000 in your browser. The hosted dashboard is a static report; rerun the analysis scripts first to refresh the underlying results.
